mapper.sql:
t.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, t.terminal_nm, t.plant_cd, p.plant_nm, t.node_id, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, t.terminal_type, t.activation_expires_at, (t.key_hash is not null) as key_issued, t.activated_at, t.last_seen_at, t.revoked_at, t.revoke_reason, t.remark, t.row_ver, t.updated_at, t.updated_by,
case when t.revoked_at is not null then 'REVOKED' when t.key_hash is not null then 'ACTIVE' when t.terminal_type = 'COLLECTOR' then 'KEY_MISSING' when t.activation_expires_at > now() then 'WAITING' else 'EXPIRED' end as state
from sys_terminal t join sys_plant p on p.comp_cd = t.comp_cd and p.plant_cd = t.plant_cd left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = t.node_id
mapper.select: select order by (t.revoked_at is not null), t.plant_cd, t.terminal_cd
select plant_cd, plant_nm from sys_plant where use_yn = 'Y' order by plant_cd
select h.node_id, h.plant_cd, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, h.node_type from mst_equip_hier h where h.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and h.node_type in ('LINE', 'CELL') and h.use_yn = 'Y' order by h.node_cd
select use_yn from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd}

insert into sys_terminal (comp_cd, terminal_cd, terminal_nm, plant_cd, node_id, terminal_type, activation_hash, activation_expires_at, remark, created_by, updated_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{f.terminalCd}, #{f.terminalNm}, #{f.plantCd}, #{f.nodeId}, #{f.terminalType}, #{activationHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{f.remark}, #{by}, #{by}) returning terminal_id
mapper.update: update sys_terminal set terminal_nm = #{f.terminalNm}, plant_cd = #{f.plantCd}, node_id = #{f.nodeId}, terminal_type = #{f.terminalType}, remark = #{f.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where terminal_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{f.rowVer} and revoked_at is null

update sys_terminal set activation_hash = #{activationHash}, activation_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, key_hash = null, activated_at = null, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where terminal_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and revoked_at is null

update sys_terminal set revoked_at = now(), revoke_reason = #{reason}, key_hash = null, activation_hash = null, activation_expires_at = null, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where terminal_id = #{id} and row_ver = #{rowVer} and revoked_at is null
mapper.select: select terminal_id from sys_terminal where activation_hash = #{activationHash} and activation_expires_at > now() and revoked_at is null for update
mapper.update: update sys_terminal set key_hash = #{keyHash}, activation_hash = null, activation_expires_at = null, activated_at = now(), last_seen_at = now(), row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = 'POP' where terminal_id = #{id} and revoked_at is null and activation_hash is not null
mapper.select: select t.terminal_id, t.terminal_cd, t.terminal_nm, t.plant_cd, t.node_id, h.node_cd, h.node_nm, t.terminal_type, t.key_hash, t.last_seen_at, p.use_yn as plant_use_yn, c.status_cd as comp_status from sys_terminal t join sys_plant p on p.comp_cd = t.comp_cd and p.plant_cd = t.plant_cd join sys_comp c on c.comp_cd = t.comp_cd left join mst_equip_hier h on h.node_id = t.node_id where t.terminal_id = #{id} and t.revoked_at is null
mapper.update: update sys_terminal set last_seen_at = now() where terminal_id = #{id} and (last_seen_at is null or last_seen_at < now() - interval '1 minute')
mapper.sql: w.worker_id, w.worker_cd, w.worker_nm, w.use_yn, w.pin_hash, w.pin_fail_cnt, w.pin_locked_until
mapper.select: select from mst_worker w where w.badge_hash = #{badgeHash}

select exists ( select 1 from mst_worker_qual h join mst_qual q on q.qual_id = h.qual_id where h.worker_id = #{workerId} and q.qual_cd = #{qualCd} and q.use_yn = 'Y' and h.acquired_on <= #{today} and (h.expires_on is null or h.expires_on >= #{today}) and (h.revoked_on is null or h.revoked_on > #{today}))
select from mst_worker w where w.worker_id = #{id}

update mst_worker set pin_fail_cnt = case when pin_locked_until is not null then 1 else pin_fail_cnt + 1 end, pin_locked_until = case when (case when pin_locked_until is not null then 1 else pin_fail_cnt + 1 end) >= #{lockAt} then #{lockEnd} else null end where worker_id = #{id} and (pin_locked_until is null or pin_locked_until <= #{now}) returning pin_fail_cnt
mapper.update: update mst_worker set pin_fail_cnt = case when pin_fail_cnt = #{claimed} then 0 else greatest(pin_fail_cnt - 1, 0) end, pin_locked_until = case when pin_fail_cnt = #{claimed} then null else pin_locked_until end where worker_id = #{id} and (pin_fail_cnt <> 0 or pin_locked_until is not null)
